regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and SI availability banner
regions.finding: The actual article title and aggregate Pd-catalyzed asymmetric allenyl C–P method were inspected. Although online SI is advertised, workspace SI association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1a representative compounds
regions.finding: Representative axially chiral biaryls/allenyl phosphorus compounds and cited literature context only; no current-paper experiment or yield is assigned.

regions.region: page 1 Scheme 1b generic strategy and tautomer/coordination challenge
regions.finding: Classified as a general scheme with generic metal/ligand/R groups and desired/undesired regioisomers, not as a performed experiment.

regions.region: page 1 right-column ligand-screening narrative
regions.finding: Narrative L1–L21 results map to the 21 independent Table 1 rows on page 2. L18 is highlighted at 69% NMR yield/86% ee; no prose-only duplicate record was created.

unresolved: Scheme 1 generic structures do not define unique compounds or conditions.
Ligand structures remain label-only and machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, L1–L21 structures, values, and footnote
regions.finding: Twenty-one independent ligand-screening experiments were retained with common absolute charges, Pd/ligand loading, THF, 70 °C/11 h/N2, 1H-NMR yields, and HPLC ee values. Signed negative ee values remain signed source values.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 2 entries 1–6 and footnote
regions.finding: Six independent leaving-group experiments were retained with product NMR yield, HPLC ee, and reagent-2a recovery kept as separate recovery outcomes.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 entries 1–14 and footnotes
regions.finding: Fourteen solvent/Pd-source screening runs were retained. Entry 12's ee dash is a source marker, entry 14 has separate 0.8 mL MTBE and 0.2 mL THF, and the CMPE-table/CPME-prose conflict remains explicit.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 2 H-phosphonate scope and footnotes
regions.finding: Nine separate H-phosphonate trials were retained, including explicit zero-product 2f/2g failures, 2h/2i room-temperature solvent/time overrides, and the 2i s factor of 44.

unresolved: Workups, purifications, isolated masses, and detailed analytical methods are absent for the screening rows.
Table 3 solvent abbreviation conflicts between CMPE and CPME.

regions.region: page 3 upper Scheme 3 reaction header and footnotes
regions.finding: The drawing uses cyclic phosphonate 2i, while footnote a prints 2a (0.5 mmol); the reactant-identity conflict is retained in every affected row. Shared THF/rt/N2/5 h conditions and b–e overrides were applied only to their marked products.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 3 product grid, 33 arrows/outcomes
regions.finding: Thirty-three distinct propargylic-substrate scope trials were retained, including one not-obtained 5ei/86% 4e recovery, one cholesterol-derived de result, one MTBE override, three 10 h overrides, one 11 h override, and one 8 h override.

regions.region: page 3 crystal depictions for (R)-3hi and (R)-5ci
regions.finding: CCDC 2039512 and 2082131 characterize products of existing scope rows; they are not new preparations, not associated SI files, and not machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 3 lower narrative on Tables 2–3 and Scheme 2
regions.finding: Narrative solvent/Pd effects and scope summaries map to the row records on pages 2–3; no aggregate duplicate reactions were created.

unresolved: Scheme 3 drawing/footnote conflict: 2i versus printed 2a (0.5 mmol).
Main text omits operational workups, masses, and detailed selectivity analyses.
Complex structures remain label-only where encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 4a kinetic-resolution time-course graph
regions.finding: One actual time-course study of rac-1x/2i was retained with product/recovered-substrate ee profiles and kinetic-resolution interpretation. Unlabeled plot points were not converted to exact numbers.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 4b catalyst-loading rate graph
regions.finding: One catalyst-loading study was retained with X mol% Pd, 2.4X mol% L18, THF/rt/20 min, regression y = 0.0004x − 0.0003, R² = 0.9951, and M/min rate units.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 4c nonlinear-effect graph at 5 min
regions.finding: One variable-ligand-ee study was retained with approximately 20% yield and the printed regression/R²; plotted points were not promoted to exact facts.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 4d nonlinear-effect graph at 40 min
regions.finding: A separate 40 min variable-ligand-ee study was retained with approximately 50% yield and its own regression/R².

regions.region: page 4 lower scope/mechanistic narrative
regions.finding: The text completes Scheme 3 scope interpretation and introduces Scheme 4; it does not add independent rows beyond the graph experiments and existing scope records.

unresolved: Exact graph coordinates and analytical methods are not tabulated.
The term standard conditions relies on Scheme 3 context.
No operational workups or isolated masses are reported.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Scheme 5 equations 1–3
regions.finding: Three distinct (S)-1t stereochemical-control experiments were retained for (R,R)-L18, (S,S)-L18, and DPEPhos, with separate yields and ee values.

regions.region: page 5 center-left Scheme 6a comparative kinetic curves
regions.finding: The (S)-1t and (R)-1t standard-condition runs were retained separately; plotted NMR-yield curves establish faster reaction of (S)-1t, but unlabeled points were not made exact facts.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left Scheme 6b proposed mechanism
regions.finding: Classified as a mechanism: Pd(0) anti-oxidative addition, ligand exchange, reductive elimination, and matched/mismatched kinetic-resolution model. Proposed intermediates/transition state are not preparations.

regions.region: page 5 upper-right Scheme 7a gram-scale reaction and transformations I–V
regions.finding: The gram-scale 3xi synthesis and five distinct downstream transformations were retained. Transformation I is represented as ordered 0 °C/10 min and room-temperature/1 h steps; all footnote reagents/loadings are participants.

regions.region: page 5 center-right Scheme 7b halocyclizations VI–VII and hydrolysis arrow
regions.finding: Bromination and iodination are two experiments with separate trans/cis product-targeted yields/ee values. The trans-12 air-hydrolysis transformation to crystal product 13 is a separate partial record.

unresolved: Scheme 5 ligand loadings and ee analytical methods are not printed.
Scheme 6 graph coordinates are not tabulated.
Most Scheme 7 transformations omit scale, solvent volume, workup, purification, and product mass.

regions.region: page 6 left-column Scheme 7 outcome narrative
regions.finding: Confirms the gram-scale 3xi mass/yield/ee, five transformations, two halocyclizations, and ambient-air hydrolysis used for X-ray product 13; these statements enrich the page-5 arrow records rather than duplicate them.

regions.region: page 6 summary and Associated Content/SI statement
regions.finding: Summary adds no new experiment. The paper advertises an online experimental-procedure PDF, but no SI file is explicitly associated in the workspace; no SI facts were inferred.

regions.region: page 6 accession codes
regions.finding: CCDC 2039512, 2082131, and 2102934 are crystallographic depositions for existing products, not new reaction records or associated SI files.

regions.region: page 6 acknowledgments
regions.finding: Junjie Fan is thanked for reproducing (R)-3ad, (R)-3ei, and (R)-3zi. With no independent charges, conditions, yields, or run IDs, these are provenance notes on existing rows and create no duplicate experiments.

regions.region: page 6 beginning of references
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature context only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: No SI association was established despite the article's SI availability statement.
Reproduction acknowledgments do not define separable runs.
CCDC depositions do not verify machine structure encodings.
No new experimental procedure appears outside Scheme 7 narrative on this page.
